dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual and symmetrical reduction in lateral width from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Largely smooth lateral margins with a minor localized convex bulge on the right edge relative to the sagittal plane.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; high-intensity median pixel value across the dorsal plane.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, faint greyish linear patterns and localized veining across the central and posterior dorsal areas.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; gradual gradient transitions between the white skin and faint greyish markings.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: A single high-contrast dark oval aperture (blowhole) at the anterior; multiple faint, low-contrast linear rake marks visible on the mid-dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible thin linear markings on the dorsal plane consistent with superficial rake marks.
other_distinctive_markers: Prominent raised longitudinal dorsal ridge extending from the mid-section toward the posterior.
